testcase.system-out: Scenario: Reopen the dialog after cancelling a folder change ✔ Given a writable copy of `fixtures/cad/document-opening/folder-navigation/NativeParent/NativeChild/NavigationDrawing.odd` is staged in a child folder ✔ And the user opens and saves that drawing to establish its preview ✔ And a drawing was opened from that child folder in the MCAD Software ✔ And that drawing remains active ✔ And the Open dialog is showing the same child folder ✔ And `NavigationDrawing.odd` was opened from that child folder ✔ When the user navigates up to its parent folder ✔ And the user cancels the Open dialog ✔ Then the drawing remains active ✔ When the user reopens the Open dialog in the same session ✔ Then it displays the original child folder ✔ And the file name field identifies the previously opened drawing ✔ And the drawing preview is displayed
